consequence.statement: Existing ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. Operators need to run a storage version migration that rewrites all objects, then update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all ClusterSecretStore objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD.

original.statement: From chart 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1. Existing ClusterSecretStore objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, new or rewritten ClusterSecretStore objects are stored as v1. Existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. v1beta1 is still served in this release, so existing objects keep working. The evidence shows no failure or rejection in this release.
consequence.remediation: Optionally run a storage version migration that rewrites all ClusterSecretStore objects. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the CRD, so a future release that drops v1beta1 does not affect stored objects.

corrected.statement: In 0.16.0 the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1. v1beta1 is still served, and existing ClusterSecretStore objects keep working but stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. This is a behavior change to review, not a mandatory step in this release.

decision.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows only that spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage on clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io flips true → false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. The CRD validator, using [ev-9889c9b8706d] and [ev-e08924afdc47], confirms v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore is still an API version in both releases. Nothing in this release fails, is rejected or must be run first. The need to migrate applies only "before a later release removes v1beta1", and no evidence says such a removal is scheduled, so mandatory migration-required over-claims; this is a review-class behavior-change.
